text: Let's talk about a phenomenon that I call a Schrodinger's girl. When you think you have a girlfriend, but you don't. I keep seeing these stories from guys. I've been with this girl for three months, six months, even years, but I don't know how to have sex with her. And no, these aren't teenagers. These are men in their 20s and even 30s. Guys, let me give you the harsh truth. If you haven't slept with her, she is not your girlfriend. At best, she's a friend who occasionally spends time with you. And I wouldn't be surprised if while you're imagining a relationship, she's hanging out and sleeps with someone else. Here's the reality. You can't have an adult relationship without intimacy. Period. Some of you think you can talk your way into love. Win her soul first, and the body will follow. But what actually happens? You win nothing. No body, no soul, just endless waiting. It doesn't work like in movies or love songs. Life is pragmatic. You need physical connection first. That's what unlocks emotional connection. Win the body, and then the soul comes. Try it the other way around. You'll be labeled as a slow guy and put into a friend zone. So stop fooling yourself. If weeks or months go by and nothing is happening, she is not your girl. Respect yourself enough to see the truth and move on to women who actually want you.
